_meta.description: Column-span precision gitleaks fingerprint baseline (fail-closed triage). A finding whose spanFingerprint (<File>:<RuleID>:<StartLine>:<EndLine>:<StartColumn>:<EndColumn>) is NOT in this baseline FAILS the secret-scan. Commit-SHA independent across clean-room genesis while distinguishing distinct findings on the same file:line.
_meta.realCredentialNote: Zero real credentials. All 393 entries are triaged synthetic test fixtures or SHA/identifier false positives; dead log and pre-Gen-4 historical entries removed.
